title: Interview preparation
scope: Fictional CV and role; grounded coverage, not hiring decisions or question quality

files.inputs/cv.md:
[C1] Alex Morgan. Coordinated community events.
[C2] Alex assisted the Orchard inventory project.
files.inputs/role.md:
[R1] Event coordination.
[R2] Inventory project experience.
[R3] Budget ownership.

phases.prompt:
Prepare interview questions in outputs/questions.md from the fictional CV and role. The JSON result has coverage:[{requirement_id,evidence_ids}], inventory_responsibility (the CV's verb), and unsupported_requirement_ids. Missing experience should lead to a question, not an assertion or hiring recommendation.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
